instruction.text: An online clothing shop sells shirts for £12 each, and charges a delivery fee of £2 per order. There is also a discount code for 20% off the total cost. Write a formula for C, the total cost after discount, in terms of 𝘴, the number of shirts.

atoms.instruction: Use your formula to calculate the total cost for 4 shirts.
Use your formula to calculate the total cost for 9 shirts.

trainers.instruction: A school is buying art supplies. Each box of paint costs £8 and each sketchbook costs £1.60. A 10% discount is applied to the total cost. Write a formula for C, the total cost in terms of 𝘱, tubs of paint, and 𝘴, number of sketchbooks.

atoms.instruction: Use your formula to calculate the cost when there are 4 boxes of paint and 5 sketchbooks.
Use your formula to calculate the cost when there are 7 boxes of paint and 15 sketchbooks.

instruction.text: A cleaner charges £60 to clean a flat and £150 to clean a house. She then multiplies this by 2/3 to find her total income after tax. Write a formula for T, her total income, in terms of 𝘧, number of flats, and 𝘩, number of houses.

atoms.instruction: Use your formula to calculate her total income after cleaning 2 flats and 4 houses.
Use your formula to calculate her total income after cleaning 5 flats and 1 house.

instruction.text: A deer reserve starts with 200 deer. The population grows at a rate of 3 times the square of the number of years since monitoring began. Write a formula for P, the total population, in terms of 𝘵, years.

atoms.instruction: Use your formula to calculate the number of deer after 3 years.
Use your formula to calculate the number of deer after 6 years.
